verdict.rationale: The quickstart describes chatting with the model and using a `/upload` slash command, which implies an interactive chat session. The `--cli` flag runs a terminal version of the model, and a community user praises the "CLI interface and web server with chat" UX. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that running the llamafile opens an interactive terminal chat (the `--cli` doc describes prompt-answering, not a multi-turn session), and hands-on corroboration of multi-turn terminal chat specifically.
